chapters.title: Clocktimber Trial 1
chapters.blurb: Everything in this universe beats with a rhythm; periodic waves sweep across the land and punish those who ignore the beat. Rule set discovered by the foundry (cycle search, generation 2, proposer crossover).
chapters.text:
Clocktimber Trial 1: dawn 0 [0..21], hunt 0 [0..10], lynx 2 [0..6]
  [0] glide: their dawn += ((their action == 2) ? -4 : 0); my dawn += ((their action == 2) ? 2 : 0); my dawn += ((their action == 0) ? 3 : 0); my dawn += 1
  [1] anchor: my dawn += ((their action == 3) ? 4 : 0); my dawn += 1
  [2] erode: their hunt += 1
  [3] sever: their hunt += 1
  [4] pulse: my dawn += ((their action == 1) ? 5 : 0); my dawn += 1
  [5] bloom: their dawn += -3
  each round: my dawn += 1
  ends: (my hunt >= 10) => I lose; (my dawn >= 15) => I win; after 16 rounds higher 'dawn' wins

chapters.title: Clocktimber Trial 2
chapters.blurb: Everything in this universe beats with a rhythm; periodic waves sweep across the land and punish those who ignore the beat. Rule set discovered by the foundry (cycle search, generation 1, proposer mutation).
chapters.text:
Clocktimber Trial 2: grove 5 [0..25], timber 0 [0..5]
  [0] weave: their grove += ((their action == 1) ? -8 : -1)
  [1] surge: my grove += 2
  [2] sever: their grove += ((their action == 0) ? -2 : 0); my grove += ((their action == 2) ? 1 : 0)
  each round: my grove += 1
  ends: (my grove >= 19) => I win; after 18 rounds higher 'grove' wins

chapters.title: Clocktimber Trial 3
chapters.blurb: Everything in this universe beats with a rhythm; periodic waves sweep across the land and punish those who ignore the beat. Rule set discovered by the foundry (cycle search, generation 4, proposer crossover).
chapters.text:
Clocktimber Trial 3: dawn 5 [0..25], dusk 0 [0..5]
  [0] fracture: their dawn += ((their action == 1) ? -8 : -1)
  [1] bloom: my dawn += 2
  [2] ripple: their dawn += ((their action == 0) ? -2 : 0); my dawn += ((their action == 2) ? 1 : 0)
  [3] siphon: their dawn += ((their action == 0) ? -5 : 0); my dawn += ((their action == 0) ? 3 : 0); my dawn += ((their action == 3) ? 4 : 0); my dawn += 1
  [4] pulse: their dawn += ((their action == 2) ? -7 : -1); their dawn += ((their action == 2) ? -6 : 0); my dawn += ((their action == 2) ? 3 : 0)
  each round: my dawn += 1
  ends: (my dawn >= 19) => I win; after 18 rounds higher 'dawn' wins

tagline: Three trials of the Clocktimber. Learn each law, then outplay the adaptive rival.
